**Daily Devotional**

**June 3**

*19 And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power, 20 Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places, (Ephesians 1:19-20 KJV)*

Paul was praying that we would get a revelation of the power we already have. Not just power, but “exceeding greatness of his power”, and it is the same power that God used to raise Jesus from the dead. We don’t just have a little power, but all the power of Jesus given us in our born again spirits. This power is for us and for our benefit. If the Christian could just get hold of what this means, and renew his mind (Romans 12:2) to find out how to use this power, then he would live a blessed life here on earth right now. Jesus came to give us a better life now, not just when we get to heaven (John 10:10).

This power is only for those who believe it is there through faith, as faith is what pleases God (Hebrews 11:6), and can not do us any good unless we have the faith to know it is there, and renew our minds to the Word of God to learn how to use the power. It doesn’t do anyone any good if you don’t know it is there and how to use it. Just imagine being able to use the power of God in your everyday life, to overcome sickness, depression, worry, temptation, and every other thing that the devil would throw at you. Wow! We need to acknowledge all the good things that we, who are born again, have in us (Ephesians 1:3) so that we can do all that Jesus told us to do (John 14:12) – Praise God, let’s do it.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
